```sql
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.is_drink_item THEN oi.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS beverage_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.is_drink_order THEN o.order_id END) AS beverage_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.is_drink_item THEN p.product_id END) AS beverage_product_types
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" oi
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers" c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY beverage_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
